title: brittonastrum betonicoides
intro: Brittonastrum betonicoides, commonly known as Creeping St. John's Wort, is a plant species native to Mexico and Central America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include relieving anxiety, stress, and mild depression due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Brittonastrum betonicoides are attributed to its sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which help in treating various conditions such as insomnia, restlessness, and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
